pictures.author: Naplee12
pictures.observations: Whole800x600 view: three separate roofless pale stone west portals, middle higher, square piers with pointed rounded finials and lintel registers/curled ends. Three open passages. Circular low red enclosure/green tiled coping, open paved court and low pale-trimmed altar visible beyond. No roofed central temple.

pictures.author: rheins
pictures.observations: Whole960x600 altar/court: low roofless square gray masonry altar, pale coping/corner strips, broad straight flights with pale splayed cheeks on cardinal faces; no altar balustrade. Low circular red wall with green tiled coping and a single pale portal/red closed leaves opposite. Pavilion/trees/Beijing towers outside remain surrounding context.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Ritan ritual core: mapped low square gray altar/pale coping and corner strips, four straight cardinal stair flights with splayed pale cheeks, circular low red enclosure/green tiled coping, three open west stone portals and one closed red-leaf stone portal on each other cardinal approach. Original simplified pointed finials/scroll ends and shallow stone decoration. No roofed central temple, invented altar balustrade or copied inscriptions/sculpture/mural atlas. Other park pavilions, northwest auxiliary halls, Sun Worship mural and landscaping remain separate host context, not claimed authored in this ritual-core model.
